opt_in_note: OPT-IN development build. This config exists so the native DPLM routes can be selected deliberately; it does NOT replace configs/experiments/her2_generative_routes.json, which still enables exactly ablang2_masked_editor, piggen_causal_infiller and dwjs_energy and is byte-for-byte untouched. The revision id and the run-root leaf differ from that config's, so a run of this one can never resume or overwrite the frozen live flight's root. Nothing here has been run: no GPU qualification, no profile, no smoke, no pretrained-weight numerical parity. Every scientific setting below is a starting point, not a measured optimum.

artifacts.root_note: the SAME artifact volume as the existing flight, read for its data and native package only. Run-stage writes land under runs/dplm_rev01/flight_dplm; the explicit acquisition/cache writes (the DPLM files under models/, data/dplm_acquisition_manifest.json and the reader cache) go under this artifact root but outside the runroot. No path of the live revision's runroot is a write target. Override with --artifact-root; it must be absolute.
artifacts.dplm_acquisition_note: the DPLM weights, config and vocabulary enter the frozen external identity ONLY through this manifest (written by scripts/her2_routes_verify_dplm.py --write-manifest after the pinned files are placed). The acquire stage refuses a DPLM route whose manifest is absent, or whose files are not in the derived closure, or whose manifest digests differ from configs/experiments/dplm_pins.json.
artifacts.external_sources_note: DERIVED from the acquisition manifests, exactly as in the base config. The DPLM files are models/dplm_150m/* and models/dplm_650m/*, which the derivation selects because they sit under models/.

dplm.pins_note: commit ids, file sizes and digests for both variants. The training identity folds in the pins digest, the base file digests, the LoRA settings, the optimizer policy and the diffusion settings, so changing any of them refuses a resume.

roots.historical_note: read-only; the run root is checked for disjointness against every one of these before the first write.

source.extra_files_note: the pins file is hashed into the repository snapshot as well as into every training identity.
source.rule: as in the base config: the freeze computes the transitive module-level AST import closure from these entry points, copies every file's bytes into the run root and records one aggregate content digest plus HEAD and the full dirty list.

revisions.reason: the first development revision that enables the native DPLM routes. It is independent of t1_rev01: nothing is resumed or transferred from it.
revisions.rule: a development revision may be superseded by a new one if a round finds a real training-path bug; the old root is retained read-only and NEVER resumed.

her2.note: the offsets are asserted constants in her2_data; a disagreement fails in her2_data.load_scaffold.

conditions.assays_note: PREFLIGHT ONLY: these names size the condition tables for the preflight native-evidence probes. The production vocabulary is DERIVED from the enrolled training partitions and pinned in condition_vocabulary.json by the sources stage.
conditions.rule: three independent tables: family (never dropped), bin and assay (dropped independently). Same as the base config.

sources.paths_note: identical to the base config: the existing data artifacts are reused in place and none is copied or rewritten.

her2_display.note: as in the base config. The test split is never read.

withheld.note: declared before any fit, identical to the base config.

split.algorithm: identical to the base config; the split is a function of sequences alone and is re-frozen in this run root.
split.primary_endpoint: the PAIRED per-core difference against the frozen control, bootstrapped over cores.
split.batch_caveat: batches are not biological families and not bootstrap units.

routes.enabled_note: the two native DPLM routes ONLY. The three original routes are not enabled here; they run under the base config. Both DPLM routes are UNQUALIFIED on this GPU: the profile stage measures whether either fits the declared spill signals, and a route that does not fit stops the flight at a feasibility gate rather than being shrunk to fit.

dplm_150m_masked.why: full fine-tuning of the pretrained 150M DPLM. Adafactor (transformers.optimization.Adafactor with fixed-LR options, factored second moments and no first moment) is what brings the persistent state under the card: fp32 weights + gradients + factored moments is roughly 1.2 GiB of persistent state before activations. That is arithmetic, not a measurement, and the WDDM-reported budget is not physical capacity; whether this route fits this GPU is unqualified and is decided by the profile stage. Reconstruction is trained with sampled-timestep absorbing-state corruption (T=500) as DPLM was; the functional, local and head tasks keep their masked-window semantics. decode_steps=20 covers a ten-site window with two steps per site; a longer schedule costs proportionally more forwards and is not free.
dplm_150m_masked.compute_note: diffusion decoding costs decode_steps denoiser forwards per draw batch plus a fixed-order rescoring of every final window. The profile forecast covers TRAINING only and says so in its per-route 'excludes' list; the decoding stage reports its own measured forward counts.

dplm_650m_lora_masked.why: the pretrained 650M DPLM with a FROZEN base and rank-16 LoRA on Q, K, V, the attention output and both FFN projections of every layer (six exact module paths per layer). The base rests in fp16 on CUDA (fp32 on CPU) and every operation computes in fp32; LoRA factors, the condition tables and the observation heads are fp32 and trainable. Roughly 1.3 GiB of resting base is arithmetic, not a measurement; the WDDM-reported budget is not physical capacity, qualification on this GPU is pending, and this route may fail the profile's spill signals on this card. That outcome is reported; the route is not shrunk.
dplm_650m_lora_masked.compute_note: as for dplm_150m_masked. Post-training holds a second full copy of the base for its frozen reference, which is a further VRAM and CPU-RAM cost that has not been qualified.

excluded.three_original_routes: not enabled in this opt-in config; they run under configs/experiments/her2_generative_routes.json.
excluded.iglm_13m: its native interface is single-chain, and the plan itself requires justifying any paired extension. Recorded as excluded with the reason rather than dropped.

curriculum.status: identical to the base config's values (they are sweep centres). mask_fraction still governs the masked-window views of every task; the DPLM routes replace it with sampled-timestep corruption for the RECONSTRUCTION task only, through routes.<route>.objective.reconstruction.

optimization.selection_metric: negative development affinity Spearman under the high-affinity condition
optimization.shape_note: microbatch and accumulation are DECLARED here and overridden by whatever the profile stage accepted (services.selected_shapes). The 150M route inherits learning_rate; the 650M LoRA route names its own in routes.<route>.optimizer.
optimization.exposure_note: row presentations, student forwards and denoiser forwards are separate counters; see the base config.

smoke.rule: a miniature end-to-end run against the production curriculum stream, with the resumed trajectory compared step for step.

profile.acceptance_note: a microbatch is accepted only when every profiled task accepted it, judged on the NVML framebuffer reading, the allocator peak and the per-row step time.

gates.criterion: unchanged from the base config: Pareto and predeclared. The raw-generation endpoint for the DPLM routes draws with their native iterative decoder, for the trained model and its frozen backbone alike.

controls.rule: matched ROW exposure across arms, with forward counts reported rather than matched.

functional_selection.why: a fitted predictor of the measured outcome from the window's residues, as in the base config.

neighbour_mean.why: run to report its measured degeneracy, as in the base config.

structural_esmif1.reason: not enrolled; runtime path incomplete (audit HR-20). Unchanged from the base config.

priors.rule: every teacher is fitted, qualified against both controls, and only then does the student take an optimizer step. The distilled checkpoint is the explicit start of post-training when it exists.

posttrain.rule: each arm starts from the resolved lineage checkpoint (priors' distilled model when one exists, otherwise the bake-off best, with the fallback recorded) with its own frozen reference and pair bank.

decoding.strategy_note: diffusion_reparam is the native DPLM decoder (iterative reparameterized decoding over decode_steps forwards, canonical residues only, scaffold immutable). Its trajectory has no normalized log probability and none is reported; the recorded value is a fixed-order rescoring of the final window. At 100,000 draws and decode_steps=20 it is a long stage; that cost is not in the training forecast.
decoding.reporting_functional: the fixed declared-order joint, temperature 1. Ranking across windows uses the MEAN log probability, never the raw sum.
decoding.clustering_rule: one global assignment, built once from the pooled candidates of every arm at the maximum draw count.

confirmation.learning_curve_note: off in this development build: its four extra fits are outside the profile forecast, and the confirmation itself cannot yet replay a qualified teacher or a post-training method (audit HR-08), so the panel reports the configuration fact that blocked it.
confirmation.recipe_note: the confirmation consumes the recipe the confirmation_freeze stage froze. That stage REFUSES, before any marker, opening or training, a recipe that names a qualified teacher, a post-training method or a decoding strategy, because replay of those is not implemented. This build therefore cannot complete T6 for a real recipe; that gap is recorded, not hidden.
confirmation.rule: three seeds of the frozen recipe under the confirmation revision; the reserved test is opened ONCE.

runtime.determinism_note: strict CUDA resume reproducibility, CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8 set before torch import. Not verified for the DPLM routes on CUDA.
runtime.scope_rule: no component is dropped to meet a runtime target; the measured cost is reported.
runtime.no_deadline: a forecast is reported whether or not it fits, and an incomplete flight is never relabelled complete.

storage.note: sized for the largest DPLM checkpoint: the 150M full state (fp32 weights, about 0.6 GB) plus its factored Adafactor state. The 650M LoRA checkpoint holds only adapters, condition tables and heads plus AdamW moments, well under this. Neither figure has been measured on a real run.

tolerances.basis: the repository's own measured figures from her2_policy; not widened here.
